sample_note: Game 3 only. Events observed from the video. rally_number and point_number restart at 1 inside this game.

conventions.time_sec: Seconds from the start of the video.
conventions.reaction_sec: contact_sec minus stimulus_sec. stimulus is opponent_contact or ball_bounce.

court.x_m: 0 at the left sideline in the video, 6.096 at the right sideline.
court.y_m: 0 at the far baseline, 13.4112 at the near baseline.

conventions.rally_number: 1-based order of the rally in the match.
conventions.shot_count: Number of player contacts in that rally.
conventions.shot_id: Joins one contact across gesture, ball speed, reaction, attack, error, and the bounce it produced. Null when the player missed the ball and made no contact.

attack_result.successful: The attack won the point, or the opponent missed the next ball.
attack_result.unsuccessful: The attack stayed in the rally, or the attack itself missed.
